title: Powers
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.261 Numbered Discourses 4.261
  • 26. Abhiññāvagga 26. Insight

Balasutta Powers

“Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, balāni. “Mendicants, there are these four powers. Katamāni cattāri? What four? Vīriyabalaṁ, satibalaṁ, samādhibalaṁ, paññābalaṁ—The powers of energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom. Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri balānī”ti. These are the four powers.”

Aṭṭhamaṁ.
